# Summary
Tick_data_top_200_summary <- Tickdata_Top_200 %>%
  group_by(Symbol) %>%
  summarise(TotalTrades = n(), TotalValue = sum(TradeValue), AvgPrice = mean(Tradeprice, na.rm = TRUE), TradeTime, .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalValue))

Tick_data_top_200_summary<- Tickdata_Top_200 %>%
  group_by(Symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalTrades = n(),
    TotalValue = sum(TradeValue, na.rm = TRUE),
    AvgPrice = mean(Tradeprice, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalValue)) %>%
  mutate(
    Decile = ntile(-TotalValue, 10)  # Decile 1 = highest turnover
  )

View(Tick_data_top_200_summary)

Tickdata_Top_200 <- Tickdata_Top_200 %>%
  left_join(
    Tick_data_top_200_summary %>% select(Symbol, Decile),
    by = "Symbol"
  )%>%
  arrange(Symbol)

Creating 30 sec buckets for each Symbol First discretizing by 1-sec and then creating TimeBucket2 for 30-sec intervals Then we are computing log returns for each Stock at each 30 sec interval

Tickdata_Top_200 <- Tickdata_Top_200 %>% 
  mutate(TimeBucket1 = floor_date(TradeTime, unit = "1 second")) %>% 
  arrange(Symbol, TimeBucket1)


Tickdata_Top_200 <- Tickdata_Top_200 %>% 
  mutate(TimeBucket2 = ceiling_date(TimeBucket1, unit = "30 seconds")) %>% 
  arrange(Symbol, TimeBucket2)

Returns_30s <- Tickdata_Top_200 %>% 
  group_by(Symbol, TimeBucket2) %>% 
  summarise(AvgPrice = mean(Tradeprice, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(Symbol)%>%
  arrange(TimeBucket2)%>%
  mutate(Return = log(AvgPrice / lag(AvgPrice))) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Return))

View(Returns_30s)

# Portfolio aggregation by decile (equal weighted returns)
# merge decile info into the returns data 

Returns_30s <- Returns_30s %>% 
  left_join(Tickdata_Top_200 %>% select(Symbol,Decile) %>% distinct(), by = "Symbol")

# Equal weighted portfolio returns by decile and time

Portfolio_returns <- Returns_30s %>% 
  group_by(Decile, TimeBucket2) %>% 
  summarise(DecileReturn = mean(Return, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
View(Portfolio_returns)

Portfolio_returns$DecileReturn<-format(Portfolio_returns$DecileReturn,scientific = FALSE)

Portfolio_values<-Tickdata_Top_200%>%
  group_by(Decile,TimeBucket2)%>%
  summarise(
    PortfolioValue=sum(TradeValue,na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

Portfolio_combined<-Portfolio_returns%>%
  left_join(Portfolio_values, by=c("Decile","TimeBucket2"))%>%
  mutate(
    DecileReturn=as.numeric(DecileReturn),
    PortfolioValue=as.numeric(PortfolioValue),
    AbsoluteReturn_Rupees= DecileReturn*PortfolioValue)

Calculating VaR value value using Three Methods:

# Historical var for each decile 

Portfolio_returns<-Portfolio_returns%>%
  mutate(DecileReturn=as.numeric(DecileReturn))

Hist_VaR_results <- Portfolio_returns %>% 
  group_by(Decile) %>% 
  summarise(
    Hist_VaR_95 = quantile(DecileReturn, probs = 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hist_ES_95=mean(DecileReturn[DecileReturn<=quantile(DecileReturn,probs=0.05,na.rm=TRUE)],na.rm=TRUE),
    Hist_VaR_99 = quantile(DecileReturn, probs = 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
    Hist_ES_99=mean(DecileReturn[DecileReturn<=quantile(DecileReturn,probs=0.01,na.rm=TRUE)],na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
View(Hist_VaR_results)

# Plotting of historical var
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
Var_long <- Hist_VaR_results %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Hist"), names_to = "ConfidenceLevel", values_to = "VaR")

# clean up labels 
Var_long$ConfidenceLevel <- recode(Var_long$ConfidenceLevel,
                                   Hist_VaR_95 = "95% VaR", 
                                   Hist_VaR_99 = "99% VaR")

ggplot(Var_long, aes(x = factor(Decile), y = VaR, fill = ConfidenceLevel)) + 
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + 
  labs(title = "historical var by decile, 30s returns", 
       x = "Decile(1 = highest turnover)", 
       y = "value at risk", 
       fill = "Confidence Level") + theme_minimal() + scale_fill_manual(values = c("95% VaR" = "#F8766D", "99% VaR" = "#00BFC4"))

# Parametric normal VaR (gaussian returns)
# assumes returns are normally distributed

Parametric_VaR <- Portfolio_returns %>% 
  group_by(Decile) %>% 
  summarise( 
    Mean = mean(DecileReturn, na.rm = TRUE), 
    SD= sd(DecileReturn, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Para_VaR_95 = (Mean + qnorm(0.05) * SD), 
    Para_VaR_99 = (Mean + qnorm(0.01) * SD))
View(Parametric_VaR)

Parametric_VaR<-Parametric_VaR%>%
  select(Decile,Para_VaR_95,Para_VaR_99)

Parametric_ES <- Portfolio_returns %>%
  group_by(Decile) %>% 
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(DecileReturn, na.rm = TRUE), 
    SD = sd(DecileReturn, na.rm = TRUE), 
    ES_95 = (Mean + SD * dnorm(qnorm(0.05)) / 0.05), 
    ES_99 = (Mean + SD * dnorm(qnorm(0.01))/ 0.01)
  )
View(Parametric_ES)
#Monte carlo simulation based VaR
set.seed(123)
n_sim <- 1000
Monte_carlo_VaR <- Portfolio_returns %>% 
  group_by(Decile) %>% 
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(DecileReturn, na.rm = TRUE), 
    SD = sd(DecileReturn, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(Monte_VaR_95 = quantile(rnorm(n_sim, mean = Mean, sd = SD), probs = 0.05), 
         Monte_VaR_99 = quantile(rnorm(n_sim, mean = Mean, sd = SD), probs = 0.01)) %>% select(Decile, Monte_VaR_95, Monte_VaR_99)

View(Monte_carlo_VaR)
Risk_summary <- Hist_VaR_results %>% 
    left_join(Parametric_VaR, by = "Decile") %>% 
  left_join(Monte_carlo_VaR, by = "Decile") %>%
  left_join(Parametric_ES %>% select(Decile, Param_ES_95 = ES_95, Param_ES_99 = ES_99), by = "Decile")

View(Risk_summary)

Risk_long <- Risk_summary %>% pivot_longer(cols = -Decile, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

ggplot(Risk_long, aes(x = factor(Decile), y = abs(Value), fill = Metric)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + labs(title = "comparison of var and es across deciles", 
                                                         x = "Decile", 
                                                         y = "absolute value of risk metric", 
                                                         fill = "Metric Type") + 
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
